high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website "KOIMOI." The article is titled "When Matt Damon Used Ben" and discusses the potential success of a film led by Pedro Pascal's quartet, which could take the franchise total of The Fantastic Four to $1 billion worldwide. Currently, the franchise stands at a total of $801 million with three films. It mentions that the most successful film has been the first Fantastic Four, which collected $333 million worldwide. The top part of the image shows a video thumbnail featuring two individuals, one smiling and the other partially obscured.
